description: UDK 2011-09 Lightmass calibration bakes (EXP-18): per receiver, the light direction in the top-face tangent frame and the median top-face texels and slot scales of the three lightmap textures (BakeCalib2-5); for point and spot lights (BakeCalib6-7), per floor the light and how the fitted model compares texel by texel. Own scenes; no game data.

BakeCalib6.method: every top-face texel (udk_calib_read.py --texels); model = brightness x linear colour max x S(e, alpha) x (1-(d/R)^2)^F x spot cone x max(0, l.b_i); channels with prediction > 0.05 and l.b_i > 0.3 compared

BakeCalib7.method: every top-face texel (udk_calib_read.py --texels); model = brightness x linear colour max x S(e, alpha) x (1-(d/R)^2)^F x spot cone x max(0, l.b_i); channels with prediction > 0.05 and l.b_i > 0.3 compared

pointSpotModel.elevationTerm: S(e, alpha) = 2 sin e (1 - k alpha^2) + (c0 + c1 alpha) cos^2 e, alpha = asin(lightSourceRadius / d) in radians
pointSpotModel.fit: least squares of model/measured - 1 over 52000 texels (at most 4000 per floor) of BakeCalib6 and 7, strongest channel per texel; pooled rms 0.054
pointSpotModel.falloff: (1 - (d/R)^2)^F with d from the light centre
pointSpotModel.spotCone: clamp((cos theta - cos outer) / (cos inner - cos outer), 0, 1)^2
